findings.old: 1.1 In disequilibria, changing and changing back is a stable-forming method
findings.finding: New title loses stable-forming, which the body leans on ('going on is stable-forming', 'a stable form is an artifact of a living self's stable-forming').
findings.proposed: 1.1 Changing and changing back, a stable-forming self observing from its own side

findings.old: 1.2 No container, and no competency coming from anywhere
findings.finding: New title loses the container value the body depends on (surface, no container, reused in 1.3) and the closing movement of the section, an interior being an accounting's placing.
findings.proposed: 1.2 A self a surface, competency a middle, an interior an accounting's placing

findings.finding: 'Unrelationing' is not a word the body uses alone (it uses un-relating and co-unrelationing), and the part also holds geodesic co-chaining, patterning and one method at each scale, so the new title is narrower than its sections and drops the body's own 'freeing'.
'A web of co-linears' names something 2.5 does not hold: there is no web in the body, and co-linear belongs to 2.6.
findings.proposed: 2.5 Patterning along and betweening across, one co-chaining with two sides

findings.finding: Drops testing, which 3.1-3.5 and 1.4 (freeing sharing, testing receiving) depend on; 3.6 also says concept-inverting is resolving, not testing, so 'Resolving' alone parts from the testing sections.

findings.old: 3.3 What a method removes is same-existing nowhere after
findings.finding: New wording is unclear and loses the section's claim that a removed possibling is gone from later observings; it also reads almost the same as the new 3.4.
findings.proposed: 3.3 What a method removes, gone from each later observing

findings.old: 4.6 The gather has half the competency and all the increase
findings.finding: Loses the body's contrast, a reaching's competency constant per observing and a gathering's climbing; 'each reaching comes to its increase' also reads as the reaching increasing, which the body parts from.
findings.proposed: 4.6 A reaching's competency constant, a gathering's climbing

findings.old: 5.5 Why an accounting reaches nowhere near the changing
findings.finding: New title only names the two things and loses the section's point, that an accounting has no column for a changing and converts it to a level or a rate; wording is unclear.
findings.proposed: 5.5 An accounting converting a changing between state and flow to a level or a rate

findings.finding: 'A swarm orienting' names something part 6 does not hold: swarm appears nowhere in it and orienting is not its subject; the new title also drops the part's possibling-open movement (6.6).
findings.proposed: 6 Between selves, a same-existing-society co-competencing and going on open

findings.old: 6.5 Too hard to be practical yet is three conditions
findings.finding: 'Three sensings parting' is unclear (parting reads as leaving); the body says a method separates three sensings.
findings.proposed: 6.5 Too hard to be practical, a separating of three sensings

findings.old: 7.1 Gather backward, seat forward, keep no log
findings.finding: New title loses the log value, which the body states three times (logs nothing, logging nothing); the positive form is seating to living files.
findings.proposed: 7.1 Gathering backward and seating forward to living files

findings.old: 7.3 The four opens and the one closing thing
findings.finding: 'One form still' is unclear (still reads as an adverb or as a standing form) and the body's word is closure of a schema.
findings.proposed: 7.3 Four opens and one closure, a schema
